anchors.german: eine so feste und reine Andeutung
anchors.english: an indication of the grammatical relation in the audible part of language itself that is so fixed and pure
anchors.label: definition
anchors.note: Fixed and pure audible indication; the full sentence retains both conditions.

anchors.german: und die Art der Andeutung gar nicht für eine Begriffsbezeichnung genommen werden kann
anchors.english: and that the manner of indication cannot be taken as a designation of a concept at all
anchors.label: shared-condition
anchors.note: Second criterion kept under that, not an unconditioned general assertion.

anchors.german: einen festen, nicht wieder nur an seiner Stellung erkenntlichen Punkt
anchors.english: a fixed point that is not itself recognizable merely by its position
anchors.label: independent-point
anchors.note: Independent identifiability, not merely fixed serial order.

anchors.english: through a concept with substantive content
anchors.label: content-concept
anchors.note: Content need not be a noun or concrete object.

anchors.german: wenn man nur nicht darauf achtet
anchors.label: observer-proviso

anchors.german: weil es ihr an einem festen Mittelpunkt ausser ihr fehlt
anchors.english: because it lacks a fixed centre outside itself
anchors.label: outside-order
anchors.note: Itself refers to position, not to language or an external metaphysical realm.

anchors.label: relation-word
anchors.note: Actual does not silently replace ächt with the same English word.

anchors.german: es lässt sich also nicht immer allein mehr der Sprache ansehen
anchors.english: it is no longer always possible to tell from the language alone
anchors.label: alone-limit
anchors.note: Retains not always and the evidential limitation.

anchors.german: man müsste dazu die Auffassungsweise der Nation, und diese in verschiednen Epochen kennen
anchors.english: one would have to know the nation’s manner of apprehension, and to know it at different epochs
anchors.label: historical-knowledge
anchors.note: Historical knowledge remains a requirement, not supplied evidence.
